Overview

Lampang is a city in Lampang with a population of 55,000. A charming northern Thai city known for its horse-drawn carriages, the Wat Phra That Lampang Luang temple, and its historic ceramic industry. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 250 sunny days a year.
